titles.native: デラックスだよ！貝社員

description:
With the conclusion of Asa Da yo! Kai Shain's TV broadcast it gets reborn with a brand new story and new characters, though some will make a comeback. This time it follows the human Kamoyama who was on his way to becoming a corporate elite when a mistake sent him to work as the manager for the Sale Department Z filled with selfish (shellfish) incompetent employees. He aims to regain his corporate elitism by converting these clamployees into decent members of the workforce with good sales results. But their laziness knows no bounds.

(Source: MAL)
